definitions.explanation: A stone slab or pillar with an inscription, erected to commemorate a person, event, or achievement. Found at historical sites, temples, shrines, and along old roads throughout Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{石碑|せきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}っている→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: There is a stone monument standing in the park.

examples.japanese: {石碑|せきひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刻|きざ}まれた→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the characters inscribed on the stone monument.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犠牲者|ぎせいしゃ}→犠牲者：18769_giseisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追悼|ついとう}→追悼：14312_tsuitou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{石碑|せきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: A stone monument was erected to commemorate the war victims.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly found at historical sites, temples, and shrines. The related word {碑|ひ} by itself also means monument/stele but is more literary. {記念碑|きねんひ} specifically means a commemorative monument.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石碑|せきひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧: to erect a stone monument
- {石碑|せきひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刻|きざ}む→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧: to inscribe on a monument
- {石碑|せきひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧: a monument stands
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{石碑|せきひ}: an old stone monument
